entities.name: Cícero Sandroni
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cícero Augusto Ribeiro Sandroni was a Brazilian journalist and writer. He was born in São Paulo and became a journalist in Rio de Janeiro, where he worked for newspapers such as O Globo and Correio da Manhã and the news magazine Manchete. He also worked in publishing and in broadcast media.
